_comment: AVWAP NIFTY F&O option-selling system. Copy to config.json and fill in your Dhan credentials. TRADING_MODE MUST be PAPER until the strategy is validated. LIVE requires explicit confirmation (see README).

market_data._universe_comment: Optional: curated list of liquid F&O stocks to trade, e.g. ["RELIANCE", "HDFCBANK", "INFY", ...]. Empty [] = the full ~210-stock F&O universe from the Dhan master. A curated list of 67 high-liquidity stocks ships in config/config.json.
market_data._indices_comment: Optional NSE INDEX options to trade with the SAME ATM±6 ITM logic as stocks, e.g. ["NIFTY", "BANKNIFTY"]. Empty [] = none. (BSE/SENSEX is not supported by Dhan market data.)
market_data._weekly_comment: Map of underlying -> number of CONSECUTIVE WEEKLY expiries to trade (current week first), e.g. {"NIFTY": 2} = current + next week. Unlisted underlyings (stocks, BANKNIFTY) use the single MONTHLY expiry with the 24th switch. Empty {} = none.
